nodes.label: Types of Motion
nodes.description: A classification of different ways objects can move.

nodes.label: Curvilinear Motion
nodes.description: The motion of a body along a curved path.

nodes.label: Examples of Curvilinear Motion
nodes.description: Instances where objects follow a curved trajectory.

nodes.label: Javelin or Shot Put
nodes.description: An object thrown by an athlete, following a parabolic path.

nodes.label: Stone Thrown by an Athlete
nodes.description: A stone propelled through the air, exhibiting a curved path.

nodes.label: Circular Motion
nodes.description: The motion of a body in a circular path.

nodes.label: Revolving Motion
nodes.description: A body moving around a fixed point by changing its position.

nodes.label: Examples of Revolving Motion
nodes.description: Instances where an object orbits another.

nodes.label: Planets around the Sun
nodes.description: Celestial bodies orbiting a star.

nodes.label: Artificial Satellite Orbiting Earth
nodes.description: Man-made objects orbiting a planet.

nodes.label: Electrons around the Nucleus
nodes.description: Subatomic particles orbiting an atomic nucleus.

nodes.label: Rotational Motion
nodes.description: A body moving around a fixed point without changing its position (spinning on its axis).

nodes.label: Examples of Rotational Motion
nodes.description: Instances where an object spins on its own axis.

nodes.label: Blades of a Fan
nodes.description: The spinning motion of fan blades.

nodes.label: A Spinning Top
nodes.description: A toy that rotates on its axis.

nodes.label: Potter's Wheel
nodes.description: A rotating disc used for shaping clay.

nodes.label: Windmill Blades
nodes.description: The rotating blades of a windmill.

nodes.label: Earth around its own axis
nodes.description: The daily rotation of the Earth.

nodes.label: Oscillatory Motion
nodes.description: The back and forth motion of a body about a mean (equilibrium) point.

nodes.label: Examples of Oscillatory Motion
nodes.description: Instances where an object moves periodically back and forth.

nodes.label: Motion of a Simple Pendulum
nodes.description: A weight swinging back and forth from a pivot point.

nodes.label: Motion of a Swing
nodes.description: A seat suspended by ropes, moving back and forth.

nodes.label: Motion of a Piston of an Engine
nodes.description: The reciprocating movement of a piston within an engine cylinder.
